# The Elementary Structures of Kinship

*[Lévi-Strauss](../philosophers/levi-strauss.md) · 1949*

[Lévi-Strauss](../philosophers/levi-strauss.md)'s thesis, which explains kinship systems by the exchange of women between groups, the incest prohibition marking the passage from nature to culture. It inaugurated structural anthropology.
